mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1100 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals a pickup in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real disposable income (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month, indicating reduced consumer spending power, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below its 3-month moving average, the combined signal of tight monetary policy and low inflation predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signaling labor market weakness, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% annually, indicating strong economic expansion, always predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
